ajaxJsonDescription: Parsley accessible file for creating endpoints or custom experiences. These files need to be named with a full path with an extension like /my/file/path.json. The file is accessible at hash-dev.preview.zesty.io/my/file/path.json. File types that can be used: css, html, json, js, xml, csv, tsv, xml, yaml, md, svg, rss, ics, vcf, xhtml.
